audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors. (a) spikes[2], whys[4] and wants.foe[2] call his ultimate 'Abyssal Voyage', a long-range roam channel. There is no such ability: his W is Abyssal Dive (a knockup gap-closer, 21s at rank 1) and his R is Devour. (b) spikes[1] and wants.foe[0] promise a Devour at level 3 — Devour is the ultimate and cannot exist before 6. (c) The 'grey health' sustain is attributed to An Acquired Taste (P). It is Thick Skin (E): 'stores a percent of the damage he takes' and converts it to a shield on a 3s cooldown. An Acquired Taste is the damage-from-health passive whose three stacks arm the Tongue Lash stun.
audit.why: (a) is the calibration-list error class and it also gives dangerous advice: mid says 'At 6 his R is just a long-range roam channel, so the straight duel still favours me'. His actual R is a lockdown. (b) oversells the pre-6 window. (c) points the player at the wrong ability when deciding whether chip is converting to a lead.
audit.corrected: Devour named as the R and gated at three stacks, Abyssal Dive named as the 21s W knockup, and Thick Skin credited for the stored-damage shield.

audit.why: Tongue Lash heals him on every champion hit on a 7s-to-5s cooldown, and Thick Skin heals him out of combat off stored damage. Flagged in _missing-interactions.json for this exact matchup.

edits.before: This is where he starts winning. My poke is real but his grey health eats it back between trades, so I can't just chip him down the way I do an immobile juggernaut. I look for one clean burst — gate-Q into a Hammer swap (armor/MR shred) into Lightning Field — and I save Thundering Blow's knockback to interrupt his Tongue Lash follow-up or shove him off when he stacks for a Devour. At 6 his R is just a long-range roam channel, so the straight duel still favours me; that level is my window to all-in before his first defensive item makes the accelerated orb bounce off.
edits.after: This is where he starts winning. My poke is real but Thick Skin banks it as a shield every 3s, so I can't chip him the way I do an immobile juggernaut, and Tongue Lash heals him on every hit — Grievous Wounds earns its slot. I look for one clean burst — gate-Q into a Hammer swap (armor/MR shred) into Lightning Field — and I save Thundering Blow to interrupt his 21s Abyssal Dive knockup or shove him off at two An Acquired Taste stacks. At 6 his R is Devour and needs three stacks first, so the straight duel still favours me; that level is my window before his first defensive item.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are mine — I take Shock Blast first and gate-poke his step-ups before he has a real HP pool for An Acquired Taste to convert into grey health, and the Mercury Cannon swap shreds his Armor/MR the moment he walks up to last-hit. The catch is the clock: the second he hits 3 his Tongue Lash slows-then-stuns me and starts stacking his passive toward a Devour, while that grey health regenerates my poke faster than I can re-stack it. So I front-load damage at 2, never auto-walk into Tongue Lash range, and I keep Hextech Capacitor's swap move-speed up to dodge the tongue.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are mine — I take Shock Blast first and gate-poke his step-ups before he has the HP pool that makes An Acquired Taste hit hard, and the Mercury Cannon swap shreds his Armor/MR the moment he walks up to last-hit. The catch is the clock: at three An Acquired Taste stacks his Tongue Lash stuns instead of merely slowing, and Thick Skin (E) banks the poke I land as a shield on a 3s cooldown, so my chip stops sticking. I front-load damage at 2, never auto-walk into Tongue Lash range, and keep Hextech Capacitor swap move-speed up to dodge the tongue.

notes: 'Abyssal Voyage' does not exist in Tahm Kench's current kit — W is Abyssal Dive, R is Devour. The page used the fake name to argue level 6 is safe for Jayce, which is dangerous advice. Also: 'grey health' is Thick Skin (E), not the An Acquired Taste passive; both layers had it backwards. late and whys[6] describe 'max-HP magic on Thundering Blow' — Riot's Jayce kit text says only 'deals magic damage and knocks them back', with no percent-health, so I neither asserted nor removed it; recorded as unverified.
